artworks.title: Orpheus Charming the Animals
artworks.description: Cuyp's Orpheus among the beasts — the grove songs after Eurydice, trees and animals gathered to the lyre.

artworks.title: Orpheus
artworks.description: Stuck's Symbolist Orpheus — the singer whose Metamorphoses inset songs still name music's power over living things.

artworks.title: Orpheus Taming Wild Animals
artworks.description: Roman mosaic — Orpheus taming wild animals, the songs episode fixed in stone for a villa floor.

music.title: L'Orfeo
music.description: Monteverdi's founding opera is itself a hymn to song's power — Orpheus' music moving the underworld.

popCulture.title: Orpheus
popCulture.description: The lyre that charms beasts, trees, and Hades — Orpheus' songs remain the West's myth of music's supremacy.
